description: The file contains C source code implementing utility functions for reading file contents into memory and printing input/output data. It includes function definitions for reading a file into a memory buffer and printing file content along with provided string data.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into a memory buffer held within a test_ut_memory_t structure, handling errors such as file open failure, seeking errors, and memory allocation issues.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file (if successfully read) and a given string, with formatted output delimiters.
